title.en: Human reproductive system, gametes and the menstrual cycle

text.en: From puberty a woman's body follows a roughly 28-day rhythm controlled by hormones from the pituitary and the ovary. It prepares the uterus every month for a possible pregnancy.

The primary reproductive organs are the testes in males and ovaries in females; the accessory organs include the vas deferens, epididymis, prostate and penis in males and the fallopian tubes, uterus, cervix and vagina in females.
The testes lie in the scrotum; sperms form in the seminiferous tubules, Sertoli cells nourish them and Leydig cells make testosterone.
The ovary has a cortex and a medulla; granulosa cells surround each ovum to form the primary follicle, which grows into the fluid-filled Graafian follicle.
Gametogenesis is the formation of haploid gametes: spermatogenesis in the male and oogenesis in the female.
A sperm has a head with a nucleus and acrosome, whose enzyme hyaluronidase helps entry into the ovum, a middle piece with mitochondria for energy and a tail for movement.
The ovum is spherical, almost free of yolk and surrounded by plasma membrane, zona pellucida, corona radiata and the vitelline membrane.
Puberty begins earlier in girls (11 to 13 years) than boys (13 to 14); LH and FSH from the pituitary control the sex hormones.
The menstrual cycle of about 28 days begins at menarche and ends at menopause around 48 to 50 years.
Its four phases: menstrual (days 1-5, lining breaks), follicular (6-13, FSH and oestrogen rise), ovulatory (day 14, LH peak releases the egg) and luteal (15-28, corpus luteum makes progesterone).
If fertilization does not occur the corpus luteum degenerates and menstruation begins; if it does, the corpus luteum persists and maintains the pregnancy.

problem.en: On which day does ovulation occur in a 28-day cycle and which hormone triggers it?

text.en: The ovulatory phase is around day 14.

why.en: It is the midpoint of the cycle.

text.en: A peak of LH from the pituitary causes the Graafian follicle to rupture.
The ovum survives about 24 hours, so fertilization must happen then.

prompt.en: Describe the structure of a sperm and the function of each part.

commonMisconceptions.en: Saying the ovum is formed in the seminiferous tubules

points.en: Testes make sperm and testosterone; ovaries make ova, oestrogen and progesterone.
Sperm: head, middle piece, tail; ovum has three membranes.
Menstrual cycle: 28 days in four phases.
Ovulation on day 14 follows the LH peak.
